articles.summary: Detection and steering methods for reward hacking work on the hacks they were trained on. We show that a small change to the task is enough to make them degrade.
articles.title: Reward Hacking Defenses Are Fragile

articles.summary: We are releasing the instruction-following variant of Steerling, which preserves the base model's interpretability.
articles.title: Steerling-8B-Instruct: Our Inherently Interpretable Instruct Model
